title: NEOPLAN USA CORPORATION: SUSPENSION:TANDEM AXLE:REAR:SUPPORT BAR:CROSS TUBE (90 affected)
summary: AXLE SYSTEM IS SUBJECT TO CRACKING OF CROSS TUBES AND TRAILING ARMS, AS WELL AS FAILURE OF MOUNTING BOLTS.

title: E-One Incorporated: BRAKES:AIR SYSTEMS:AIR SUPPLY:GAUGE:AIR PRESSURE (71 affected)
summary: USE OF THE AIR HORN CAN CAUSE THE AIR PRESSURE TO DROP BELOW 85 PSI.

title: AUTOMATIC EQUIP. MFG. CO.: STRUCTURE:TONGUE DOLLY (1,219 affected)
summary: CRACKS MAY OCCUR IN THE MATERIAL OF THE TONGUE MOUNT WHERE THREE ONE INCH HOLES ARE LOCATED TO ACCOMMODATE RUBBER GROMMETS.

title: CENTURY WRECKER CORP.: EQUIPMENT:LIFT:WRECKER (215 affected)
summary: THE L BAR LATCH WAS OF LESSER STRENGTH THAN SPECIFIED.

title: SAAB CARS USA, INC.: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:WIRING:HARNESS:UNDER DASH (70,000 affected)
summary: WIRING HARNESS MAY CHAFE AGAINST SHARP EDGES UNDER THE DASHBOARD AND AGAINST A SUPPORT UNDER THE REAR SEAT (1988 MODELS ONLY).

title: Volvo Trucks North America: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:WIRING:OTHER PART (234 affected)
summary: GROUNDING OF THE AC POWER SOURCE MAY BE DEFECTIVE (OR THERE MAY BE NO ELECTRICAL GROUNDING AT THE AC POWER SOURCE).

title: General Motors, LLC: EMERGENCY PARKING BRAKE:MECHANICAL:LINKAGES AND CA (3,857 affected)
summary: THE PARKING BRAKE CABLE MAY BE DISCONNECTED FROM THE LEFT REAR BRAKE CALIPER.

title: THE FISHER GROUP INC.: EQUIPMENT:OTHER PIECES:TRAILER HITCHES AND ATTACHM (474 affected)
summary: WELDS THAT ATTACHED TUBE AND CHAIN BRACKET TO CROSSMEMBER ASSEMBLY WERE POROUS AND INADEQUATE IN SIZE.

title: THOMAS BUILT BUSES, INC.: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:SEAT BELTS:LAP:FRONT (1,541 affected)
summary: MOVABLE PART OF SEAT IS NOT STRONG ENOUGH TO SUPPORT THE SEAT BELT.

title: Mack Trucks, Inc.: ENGINE COOLING SYSTEM:FAN (400 affected)
summary: ENGINE COOLING FAN IS SUBJECT TO HIGH STRESS AND POTENTIAL FATIGUE PROBLEMS.

title: Harley-Davidson Motor Company: POWER TRAIN:TRANSMISSION:UNKNOWN TYPE (43,058 affected)
summary: THERE MAY BE STRUCTURAL INTEGRITY PROBLEMS WITH THE SHIFTER FORKS USED IN THE TRANSMISSIONS.

title: Landoll Corporation: BRAKES:AIR SYSTEMS:LINES:HOSE:NON-METALLIC (45 affected)
summary: AIR BRAKE HOSES FAILED WATER ABSORPTION AND TENSILE STRENGTH TEST OF FMVSS 106.

title: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.): VISUAL SYSTEMS:WINDSHIELD WIPER (360,198 affected)
summary: UNDER HIGH AMBIENT TEMPERATURES FRONT WINDSHIELD WIPER CONTACT UNIT COULD LOOSEN AND BECOME DISLODGED.

title: Suzuki Motor USA, LLC: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:SEAT BELTS:LAP:FRONT (4,546 affected)
summary: SEAT BELT LATCH STALK (COATED WIRE CABLE BETWEEN THE SEAT BELT LATCH AND VEHICLE FLOOR ON THE INBOARD SIDE OF THE FRONT SEATS) CAN BECOME DAMAGED AND COULD BREAK AFTER EXTENSIVE BENDING.

title: Ford Motor Company: FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY:ATTACHMENTS (300 affected)
summary: FUEL RESERVOIR SHIELDS, THAT PROTECT THE RESERVOIR FROM CONTACT BY THE TRANSFER CASE IN CERTAIN FRONTAL IMPACTS, WERE NOT INSTALLED.

title: AM GENERAL LLC: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:WIRING:OTHER PART (50,000 affected)
summary: THE MILITARY NATO SLAVE RECEPTACLE IS NOT WATERPROOF AND WHEN SUBMERGED IN WATER A CURRENT PATH IS CREATED.

title: Collins Bus Corporation: FUEL:FUEL EMISSION CONTROL:CANISTER (159 affected)
summary: DUE TO CLOSE PROXIMITY OF FUEL EMISSION CANISTER TO THE CATALYTIC CONVERTER, VAPOR RELEASED FROM THE FUEL TANK MAY NOT BE CONSUMED AT THE ENGINE IN AN IDLE SITUATION.

title: SAAB CARS USA, INC.: FUEL:FUEL FILTER LINE (1,586 affected)
summary: FUEL FILTER MAY NOT MEET THE SPECIFICATION CONCERNING LEAKAGE CRITERIA DUE TO LOW TEMPERATURE DURING THE GLUING PROCESS.
